name: Suzette Sibble
bio: Suzette Sibble has served in the public service sector for almost three decades. She began her career with Broward County as a Student Intern, then served as an auditor with KPMG Peat Marwick for five years, elevating to Audit Manager in 2003. Ms. Sibble began her career with the City of Pompano Beach in 2004, initially serving as Controller. She was promoted to Finance Director in 2007 and Assistant City Manager in 2017. During her eighteen years with the City, she has been instrumental in establishing sound fiscal policies, navigating the City through a recession and assisting the City and its Redevelopment Agency in financing many notable capital improvement projects. Ms. Sibble earned her Master's and Bachelor's degree in Accounting from Florida International University. She is a Certified Public Accountant (CPA).She also serves as Treasurer for Shipwreck Park, Inc. and has served on several subcommittees for Broward County City Managers' Association.
